notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: I just found a terrible bug that was introduced by the new graphics update. Region-clicking and thumbnail generation were terribly broken, but now has been fixed.

notes.title: Chat Update
notes.content:
Observe now has a chat feature that you can use to control AI. This update comes with a scenario named "Civilizations". The scenario features some of the greatest empires that have ever existed, and you can send commands to them or just watch these characters vibe.

-Chat screen: 
You can write "Alexander attack Bismarck," and the Macedon Empire will start attacking Germany. You can command an AI to "focus on tech" or "focus on x tech." You can tell them to start recruiting more troops with "Recruit" or "Focus on recruit". And you can just use a command like "Genghis help," and they will tell you what you can ask them to do.

-MiniScript integration: 
You can create similar AIs to the ones already included. You can also just change the messages at the top of the included AIs and basically create your own characters.

-Now you can upload scenarios to the Workshop with scripts attached.
-You can now set a global AI script.
-It is now possible to set a global population number for empty provinces.
-There is now a text at the bottom of the screen that shows which countries have been destroyed.

Thanks for all the support! :)

notes.title: QoL and Bugfix Update
notes.content:
Hi again, today I got some good people on Discord suggesting me some features like more console commands and tooltips for map modes, so I implemented them.

Then some bugs were brought to my attention and, I fixed them too.

If you'd like to report a bug or suggest a feature, I highly recommend you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/wQBXFtck]Discord[/url] :)

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.content:
Hi, I have been working on an update for a while now. It was mostly polishing but it also has important features like console.

-Made the map look a bit better
-Added hotkeys for almost anything
-Added more stats
-Added more tooltips
-Added more music
-Added another map mode
-Fixed a lot of bugs
-Fixed a latency issue between the "real" map and the "wraparound" map
-Changed the History Shuffle's algorithm to be crazier, it used to be a lot more rigid
-Made the AI Studio simulation a lot better, it used to be so that you couldn't really control the simulation that happened inside AI Studio.
-Added 3 example scripts.
-Added 250 countries for History Shuffle
-Made 2 new scenarios
-And most importantly, I added an in-game console. Now you can use "listen [countryname]" to listen to a script's debug information. You can also do "reload [countryname]" to reload a country's script.


Next: I will be adding ideologies to the game. They'll be of course, customizable. I am right now thinking about if every ideology should also have a negative impact or not.

If you want to help with your ideas, or if you have any issues with anything, consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/wQBXFtck]Discord.[/url]

Can't wait to hear your thoughts :) thanks for being here.
